reviewer: Kimi actual visual review of the exact 156x210 source and enlarged source-page 19 crop, complete opaque RGB raw and native face crop, unchanged naiwa reference, and full white/cyan/source-alpha/RGB-no-alpha sheet/evidence. RGB art was rejected for missing brows before any alpha operation; no derivative or repair receipt was created.

remaining_reasons: The source has visible dark eyebrows beneath the cap visor, but the complete RGB raw and native face crop show no eyebrow above either green eye; the yellow brow region is bare. Restore the source's two distinct dark brow shapes while retaining the cap, friendly closed-mouth smile and all other visible features. This is an RGB hair-features-v1 failure and must not be hidden by alpha repair.
entries.positive_observation: The dark green cap retains its glossy visor with a broad pale highlight, silver-white piping/cords, separate upper silver-white eagle and lower silver wreath/cockade with a red-dark center. Hair remains covered, with no glasses, moustache or beard and one broad friendly closed-mouth smile. The near-frontal upright pose, forward gaze and original crop remain. The dark navy high-collared coat keeps broad pale grey-white scarf-like front panels, dark-and-pale patterned collar/neck detailing and one small pale-edged throat cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar, and the pale cream/light-grey-beige painted backplate fills the original rectangle. These correct properties do not offset the clearly absent eyebrows.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact construction of the pale chest panels and patterned neckwear plus fine cap and collar insignia cannot be resolved confidently at 156x210 and are not rejection grounds. The decisive brow absence is unmistakable in the native RGB crop rather than hidden by visor shadow or unreadable pixels.
